H("II. Scope, Methodology and Limitations")
H("A. Scope",2)
para("Engagement Letter §§ 3.2–3.8: roster-to-I-9 reconciliation; Section 1/Section 2 timeliness; document sufficiency (List A, or List B + List C); reverification (Section 3/Supplement B); technical completeness; retention under 8 C.F.R. § 274a.2(b)(2)(i)(A); and risk ranking with remediation. Both facilities and all classifications (full-time, part-time, seasonal) are included. E-Verify is outside scope (Engagement Letter § 8).")
H("B. Method",2)
bullet("**Matching protocol.** A roster employee was treated as having an I-9 entry only if the log contained the same employee ID and the same name. We also searched by name regardless of ID, and reviewed same-ID/different-name pairs individually for probable transcription variants.")
bullet("**Timeliness.** Section 1 must be completed no later than the first day of employment. Section 2 must be completed within three business days of that day (8 C.F.R. § 274a.2(b)(1)(ii)), e.g., a Monday hire must be completed by Thursday. We counted Monday–Friday and excluded federal holidays; the results do not change if holidays are counted. For matched records we used the roster hire date. The log has no hire-date field, so for unmatched records Section 1 date was used as a proxy.")
bullet("**Reverification.** Expiration dates were compared with the June 1, 2025 reference date; reverification is required only for temporary employment authorization (e.g., EAD/Form I-766; List C documents with expiration), never for U.S. passports/passport cards or Permanent Resident Cards.")
bullet("**Retention.** Later of three years after hire or one year after termination.")
H("C. Limitations",2)
bullet("We reviewed a summary log, not the forms. The log omits fields needed for a full technical review: document numbers, issuing authorities, form edition, preparer/translator blocks, signatures, Section 2 “first day of employment” entry, employer representative identity, and Section 1 citizenship/immigration attestation. Findings on those points require inspection of the originals (Engagement Letter § 6).")
bullet("The log is self-described as compiled from paper files, a partial digital archive, and consolidated Santa Rosa records, and the HR memo acknowledges it “may contain errors or omissions.” Several findings below may prove to be log errors rather than form defects; each is flagged with the verification step needed.")
bullet("We have not independently verified document authenticity or any individual’s immigration status (Engagement Letter § 8). Nothing herein is advice to any individual employee.")
